item.title: Hear two candidates for a shared workroom
item.summary: Two users consider which equipment to share and which needs separate booking.
item.transcript_text:
Mira: We can fit both the sewing machines and the photo table in the back room. Could people book them separately?
Daniel: Only until someone needs a quiet video. The machines would show up on the recording. Maybe the back room should keep the table and the sewing machines could go near the entrance.
Mira: There is a narrow turning space there. Someone moving a large roll of fabric would have to pass the front desk.
Daniel: Then block out quiet hours in the back room and charge both teams the same for using a larger room on event days. Let's ask what times they actually need before fixing the rule.
Mira: I'm happy to test that, but make the temporary booking rule visible to everyone.

questions.prompt: What issue is the conversation chiefly about?
options: Who owns the two types of equipment
Whether recordings should be allowed at all
Whether two activities can share a room without interfering
How to rebuild the front desk
questions.explanation: The teams need to manage incompatible uses of a shared room.

questions.prompt: What makes separate bookings insufficient at first?
options: The table uses the machines' power socket
Sewing machine noise can enter a recording
The door needs two different keys
The room is smaller than either object
questions.explanation: Both can fit, but overlapping activities create sound interference.

questions.prompt: What is the concern with putting sewing near the entrance?
options: People carrying large fabric rolls would have little space
The entrance cannot be locked
Photographers would have to cross the sewing table
It costs more to use the entrance
questions.explanation: Mira mentions a narrow turn and the front desk.

questions.prompt: What information does Daniel want before a permanent rule?
options: How to sell unused fabric
The exact weight of each machine
Who designed the table
When each team needs space
questions.explanation: He wants to understand the actual time demand first.

questions.prompt: What condition does Mira place on trying the plan?
options: Charge one team more than the other
Pause work during all event days
Make the temporary rule visible
Have both teams book only at the front desk
questions.explanation: She accepts a trial on the condition that everyone can see the rule.

children.segment_text: the machines would show up on the recording
